stages.discovery: A peddler's handcart lies overturned in a ditch beside the road, one wheel still spinning slow and crooked. The peddler himself is a few feet off, on his back, staring at nothing. Nothing about him looks fought over - just stopped, mid-step, mid-breath.

choices.label: Search the Cart
choices.description: See what he was carrying - Investigation check

check.success_outcome: Most of the cart's stock spilled into the mud and isn't worth carrying, but you spot a wrapped bundle wedged under the seat that survived the fall - a decent blade, still oiled.
check.failure_outcome: You paw through the spilled stock but everything worth taking is either ruined or too well-hidden to find in the mud and failing light.

choices.label: Close His Eyes and Move On
choices.outcome: You kneel, close his eyes, and leave his goods where they fell. Whatever took him, it isn't your place to profit from it.

choices.label: Keep Walking
choices.description: ESC also cancels - it's none of your business
choices.outcome: You give the cart a wide berth and let the road carry you past him.
